newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $9.77 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $9.77 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold 199.5 million rupees ($9.77 million) of treasury bills during its weekly auction, out from a total amount of 600 million rupees put on tender, the central bank said on Thursday.

It sold 115.5 million rupees of 91-day, 44.0 million rupees of 182-day and 40.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.53 percent, 9.60 percent and 9.87 percent respectively.
The week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.86 percent per annum from 9.68 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the central Bank of Mauritius sold 500 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.44 percent, 9.30 percent and 9.51 percent respectively.
